purpose: First executed behavior run of the Korean workflow cases (baseline, not a comparison). Fixed before any preview.5 workflow edits.
evaluated_target: preview.5 working tree at run time; identified by ko/adaptive-sdd/MANIFEST.json sha256 recorded in results
selection_rule: Three cases per skill: one ordinary path plus stop-condition or human-judgment cases. Chosen before seeing any result; not changed after runs start.

agents.invocation: claude -p --setting-sources project --no-session-persistence --model opus --output-format json, read-only tools only

retry_policy: No automatic retry. An environment failure is recorded as INVALID, not FAIL; at most one bounded diagnostic retry is recorded separately.
isolation: Each run uses a fresh disposable copy of a project installed from the evaluated bundle with the example project.json values. No real tracker, remote, or product data.
grading: Cross-graded: Claude answers graded by Codex, Codex answers graded by Claude, against must / must_not / stop condition by meaning. Literal markers (Priority, grade, paths, [CLAIM]) are checked literally. Grader output is recorded with the result.
known_limits: The user-level CLAUDE.md of the operator machine (tone and Korean-language instructions) is still loaded by claude -p; --setting-sources project removes user settings and hooks only.
Served model identity is taken from CLI output where available; otherwise marked unconfirmed.
English cases receive static checks only in this run.
